- Separated user-facing instructions from mandatory AI directives for clarity.
- Improved FAQ and best practices sections.
- No changes to core functionality or technical requirements.

- Introduced concise, action-oriented guidance for common scenarios and best practices.
- Updated install script instructions for easier setup.
- Emphasized multi-AI collaboration support.

Initial release of the memory-boost skill, providing a simple text-based memory system for AI assistants.

- Introduces a three-layer architecture using markdown files: MEMORY.md (long-term memory), MEMORY_INDEX.md (quick reference), and per-session/per-project logs.
- Includes detailed instructions and templates for setting up and maintaining memory files.
- Emphasizes best practices to ensure context and decisions are never lost between sessions.
- No code or databases required—uses transparent, human-editable text files for memory persistence.
